user.title: Add an Aqara camera
user.description: Choose a camera detected on your network, or pick 'Other' to enter an IP manually.

manual.title: Add an Aqara camera (manual)
manual.description: Enter the camera's LAN IP and RTSP credentials. RTSP must be enabled in the Aqara app under camera settings > RTSP LAN Preview.

credentials.title: Configure {name}
credentials.description: Detected an Aqara camera: {name} (model {model}). Enter the RTSP credentials configured in the Aqara app to add it.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Configure {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Detected an Aqara camera: {name} (model {model}). Enter the RTSP credentials configured in the Aqara app to add it.

error.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address (not a hostname or URL).
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to camera on port 54324. Verify the IP and that the camera is online.

abort.not_a_camera: Discovered device is not an Aqara camera.

data_description.backchannel_channel: Which RTSP channel (1 = high, 2 = medium, 3 = low) the go2rtc backchannel routes through. Default: 1.

talk_audio_file.name: Play audio file on camera
talk_audio_file.description: Play a pre-recorded AAC-ADTS audio file through the camera speaker.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Path to an AAC-ADTS audio file (16 kHz mono).

no_camera_target.message: No Aqara camera selected as target. Pass entity_id or device_id.

connect_failed.message: Failed to connect to camera -- the voice channel may already be in use by browser two-way audio or another session.

file_too_large.message: File too large ({size} bytes); maximum is {max_size} bytes.
